run_cumsum: run cumulative sum on a masked numpy array, skipping NA values by default
run_cumprod: run cumulative product on a masked numpy array with NA handling via skipna parameter
run_cummin: run cumulative minimum on a masked numpy array with fill-value substitution for NAs
run_cummax: run cumulative maximum on a masked numpy array with fill-value substitution for NAs
run_cum_func: run the internal masked accumulation function with a numpy ufunc, values array, and boolean mask
